Rashi on Sukkah 14a:1:1.hebrew: יורדין לידי טומאה במחשבה - מי שחשב עליו שזה יהא גמר מלאכתן, כגון שעיבדו לדרגש או לדולבקי, כיון שעיבדו, מקבל טומאה. ואלמלי עיבדו לרצועות וסנדלין, אין מקבלים טומאה עד שיגמרו למלאכת הסנדלין:
Rashi on Sukkah 14a:1:1.english: [Vessels] descend into ritual impurity through thought - [In the case of] one who intended regarding it that this should be the completion of its manufacture, such as where he tanned it for a dargash [couch] or for a dulebki [table] — once he has tanned it, it becomes susceptible to ritual impurity. Whereas had he tanned it for straps and sandals, they do not become susceptible to ritual impurity until they are completed for the work of the sandals.

Rashi on Sukkah 14a:1:2.hebrew: ואין עולים מטומאתן - ממחשבת תורת קבלת טומאה, אין עולין במחשבה. כגון: עיבדו לשלחן ולדרגש, וחישב עליו לרצועות וסנדלין — אין מחשבתו מבטלתן מתורת קבלת טומאה:
Rashi on Sukkah 14a:1:2.english: And they do not ascend from their ritual impurity - From the thought that [imparted] the status of susceptibility to ritual impurity, they do not ascend through thought. For example, [if] he processed [a hide] for a table or for a couch, and [then] intended it for straps and sandals, his thought does not remove them from the status of susceptibility to ritual impurity.

Rashi on Sukkah 14a:1:3.english: Only through a change resulting from an action - Until he applies a chisel to it.

Rashi on Sukkah 14a:1:4.hebrew: מעשה מבטל מידי מעשה - אפילו עשה בו מעשה מוכיח מתחילה לשלחן, כגון שקיצצו סביבותיו ליפותו, כיון שנתן איזמל בו לחתכו לסנדלין, מבטל מעשה ראשון, וכל שכן שמוציא מידי מחשבה שלא היה בה מעשה:
Rashi on Sukkah 14a:1:4.english: An action nullifies [the status created by] an action - Even if he performed on it an action that clearly demonstrates [its purpose] initially for a table [covering], such as where he trimmed around its edges to beautify it, once he applied a blade to it to cut it for sandals, [this] nullifies the first action; and all the more so does it negate [the status created by] thought, in which there was no action.

Rashi on Sukkah 14a:2:1.hebrew: וכי תימא הני מילי - דלא מבטלין בתרייתא לקמייתא בכלים דחשיבי, ומשיצא עליו שם כלי במחשבה, אינה נוחה להפקיע שמה:
Rashi on Sukkah 14a:2:1.english: And if you say this applies only - That a subsequent [thought] does not negate an earlier [thought] [applies only] to vessels, which are significant, and once the designation of a vessel has taken effect upon it through thought, it [the subsequent thought] is not readily able to revoke its designation.

Rashi on Sukkah 14a:2:2.english: That one besasan - Below, [the Gemara] explains what it is.

Rashi on Sukkah 14a:2:3.hebrew: טהורות - דגלי דעתיה דלא ניחא ליה בהו, וטהרו מלקבל טומאה הידות האלה עוד, ולא הביאה טומאה על האוכל עד שיגיע טומאה באוכל עצמו:
Rashi on Sukkah 14a:2:3.english: [Are] ritually pure - For he revealed his intention that he has no use for them, and these handles have become pure from receiving ritual impurity any longer, nor do they bring ritual impurity upon the food until ritual impurity touches the food itself.
